checks.result: 37 tests passed, including all manifest, read-only approval, CLI, operator-write, atomicity, supersession, rollback, and race-condition cases.

checks.command: Temporary TTY approval with the full displayed canonical digest
checks.result: A closed approval record was created in temporary custody, independently inspected as MATCH, and bound to the exact manifest digest, path, remote, schema, workflow, operator, and UTC approval time.

checks.command: Approve, mutate the manifest, and approve the new full digest in temporary custody
checks.result: The new record atomically replaced the active approval, exact prior bytes were retained under the superseded history, and no temporary file remained.
The operator write failed closed, restored the exact prior active record, and left no rollback temporary file.

checks.command: Mutate the manifest and current approval after the prompt but before replacement
checks.result: Post-confirmation manifest re-read, approval snapshot comparison, and prior-file digest compare-and-swap rejected both races without replacing approval.

checks.command: Invoke the interactive surface when the exact approval already matches
checks.result: The command returned success without rewriting the active approval or creating superseded history.
The real launcher returned exit 77 under redirected input, wrote no stdout approval claim, and did not create the default approval root.
The uncontracted non-interactive confirmation flag returned usage exit 64 and wrote no approval state.
The machine path returned exit 77 and IS_AUTHORITY_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN in a schema-valid envelope.

checks.command: Attempt approval creation inside repository custody
checks.result: The write failed before creating the unsafe approval root.

remediations: Pre-evidence review added post-confirmation manifest and approval snapshot rechecks plus compare-and-swap on the exact prior approval-file digest.
A failed independent post-write MATCH inspection now restores the prior active record when one existed.

retained_failures.note: PowerShell treated a no-space output-redirection token as part of the contract filename, so the parser did not run. Record normalization had succeeded, no approval state changed, and the corrected parser invocation passed.

limitations: No real manifest approval was created; every positive write used temporary custody and an injected test principal.
A simultaneous OS failure during both final verification and rollback can leave approval state requiring operator inspection; the command reports failure and grants no execution authority.
The interactive writer does not make workflow verification or execution available; those surfaces remain unimplemented.
macOS approval custody remains fail-closed pending extended-ACL verification.
scope_note: This evidence closes the operator-write portion of the IS-0002 approval boundary. It does not authorize Codex to invoke the operator command or create a real approval.
